content_text:
Like it says in the title, I need to wire up a large number of individually addressable LEDs into a set – think a forest with a number of flowers and other small set components that each light up.
Ideally RGBWW with good color rendering. Everything I’ve come across on the internet looks sketch. Any recommendations for a source to order from?
Cheers,
Teddy
